records.before_context: This is the 14-day national schedule for adolescents and young adults. No numerical age or performance-status boundary is added where the source does not supply one. The treatment starts with ifosfamide/etoposide. The final two even-numbered administrations omit doxorubicin, and dactinomycin remains optional. Trial schedules and other age-group protocols are not interchangeable.

records.before_context: This is the 50 mg/m² irinotecan, 100 mg/m² temozolomide, six-cycle Ewing regimen. Other published schedules and the vincristine-containing rhabdomyosarcoma regimen are different. The national source identifies unlicensed indication use: the team must explain the rationale and document consent under local policy, including the source drug-and-therapeutics committee requirement.
records.after_context: This is the 50 mg/m² irinotecan, 100 mg/m² temozolomide, six-cycle Ewing regimen. Other published schedules and the vincristine-containing rhabdomyosarcoma regimen are different. Use for this diagnosis is unlicensed in Ireland. Your team must explain why it is recommended, document your consent under hospital policy and confirm acknowledgement by the hospital’s Drugs and Therapeutics Committee or equivalent.

records.before_context: This is the nine-cycle regimen for high-risk or very-high-risk rhabdomyosarcoma under age 40, with performance status 0–2. It is not one unchanged calendar repeated nine times. Current mesna timing and the different early versus later growth-factor plans are part of the source-specific prescription. Product licensing and the reason for each selected medicine must be reviewed locally.
records.after_context: This is the nine-cycle regimen for high-risk or very-high-risk rhabdomyosarcoma under age 40, with performance status 0–2. It is not one unchanged calendar repeated nine times. Follow the prescribed mesna timing and the growth-factor plan for your current treatment phase; the growth-factor plan differs between earlier and later phases. Your team will explain the role of each medicine and check its licensing for your treatment.

records.before_context: The live national catalogue places this in adult treatment, while the PDF includes a wider age range and age-specific performance scales. Paediatric use requires the appropriate specialist pathway, not automatic extension of this adult portal. Temozolomide escalation and reduction depend on actual previous doses and toxicity; a recovered grade does not erase prior events. The national source identifies unlicensed indication use: the team must explain the rationale and document consent under local policy, including the source drug-and-therapeutics committee requirement.
records.after_context: This page describes adult treatment. The national regimen guidance also covers a wider age range and uses age-specific fitness criteria. Children need assessment and treatment through the appropriate specialist service. Any increase or reduction in temozolomide depends on the doses you have already received and your side effects, including previous problems that have since improved. Use for this diagnosis is unlicensed in Ireland. Your team must explain why it is recommended, document your consent under hospital policy and confirm acknowledgement by the hospital’s Drugs and Therapeutics Committee or equivalent.
